record.what_it_does: SEO platform with API for keyword, backlink, SERP, rank tracking and audit data.
record.auth_notes: REST API uses an account API key (Bearer/Token, header format not confirmed). OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration exists only on the MCP server. Keys have full account access; no scoped keys.
record.access_notes: API access is included in every plan (Core $129/mo, Growth $279/mo), and a free trial account (no credit card) can test it. API Add-On from $149/mo, and pay-as-you-go from a $50 minimum deposit. Each end user needs their own SE Ranking account and API credits.
record.api_breadth_notes: Data API (keywords, backlinks, domain analysis, SERP, site audit, AI visibility) and Project API (rank tracking, keyword groups, competitors). Endpoint count not verified, but it likely exceeds 50.
record.mcp_notes: https://api.seranking.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 or X-Api-Key). Docs at seranking.com/api/integrations/mcp/. An open-source local server also exists (github.com/seranking/seo-data-api-mcp-server, per a third-party listing).
record.blocker_notes: Free trial lets a developer test. Production use needs a paid plan or API credits. Only API keys are available for the REST API, with no scoped keys or OAuth app flow for third parties.

evidence.quote: API access is included in every SE Ranking plan.
uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication
The Data API covers keyword research, backlink analysis, domain performance, SERP data, site audits

record.needs_human: The REST auth header format, the endpoint count, whether an OpenAPI spec is published, and whether webhooks exist were not confirmed. The pricing details came from a page summary, not the pricing page itself. The sandbox answer rests on the free trial account, not a dedicated test mode.
